effects.l1: Dark veil: + Fire to Stealth while still and partly hidden.
effects.l2: Secret veil: hide Tao-level small objects on the body; searches don't find them.
effects.l3: Path of shadows: + Fire to Stealth while moving unseen; always use Stealth for combined Tests.
effects.l4: Path of ghosts: + Fire to Stealth on any subtle action, including attacking; always use Stealth.
